generic.Defined scope/population: All requestor records flagged for legal hold, retention, or fraud exemption review
generic.In-scope period: Current open DSAR case from intake through disposition
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Exemption type, statutory basis, and record ID populated for each excluded item
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of excluded items matches the count flagged in the search worklog
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Exemption determination memo saved with counsel sign-off timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any borderline exemption call logged with Privacy Counsel's final disposition
generic.Test population: Sample of applied exemptions checked against the legal hold and SIU flag source
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires every exemption traced to a documented statutory or policy basis
generic.Exception handling path: Undocumented exemption claims routed back to Privacy Counsel before release
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Exemption applied only when a legal hold, retention, or fraud flag is confirmed active
generic.Evidence location: DSAR case record in the GRC platform

steps.title: Screen requestor records for active legal hold flags
sop: Open the requestor's case file in the GRC platform.
Query the legal hold register for any flag tied to the requestor's records.
Note each flagged record and the hold reference number.
Done when every record has been checked against the legal hold register.
verify: Cross-check the flagged list against the legal hold register export.
Pass when every legal hold flag on file is captured in the case notes.

steps.title: Screen for regulatory retention requirements
sop: Check the requestor's claim and policy records for open regulatory retention markers.
Identify any filed claim or active exam requiring retention beyond normal disposition.
Log each retention marker found with its regulatory basis.
Done when all retention markers are logged on the DSAR case.
verify: Confirm each logged marker ties to an active claim or exam record.
Pass when no retention marker is missing a regulatory basis.

steps.title: Screen for open SIU or fraud investigation flags
sop: Query the GRC platform's SIU case reference for the requestor's identifiers.
Identify any open fraud investigation tied to the requestor's records.
Record the SIU case number against the flagged records.
Done when the fraud-flag screen is complete and logged.
verify: Verify the logged SIU case number is active and not closed.
Pass when every fraud flag traces to a currently open SIU case.

steps.title: Document exemption basis for each excluded item
sop: Review the legal hold, retention, and fraud flags gathered for the case.
Write the specific statutory or policy basis for each excluded item.
Attach the exemption memo to the DSAR case record in the GRC platform.
Done when every excluded item has a documented basis.
verify: Read the exemption memo against the excluded-item list.
Pass when every excluded item cites a specific statutory or policy basis.

steps.title: Obtain Privacy Counsel sign-off on the determination
sop: Route the completed exemption memo for final counsel review.
Confirm the exemption scope matches the flags identified.
Record sign-off with name and date in the GRC platform.
Done when sign-off is recorded before any release or deletion proceeds.
verify: Check the GRC platform for the recorded sign-off entry.
Pass when sign-off is present and dated before the case moves forward.

steps.title: Release the case for downstream fulfillment
sop: Confirm the exemption memo and sign-off are attached to the case.
Update the case status to exemptions-applied in the GRC platform.
Notify the fulfillment team the case is ready for the next step.
Done when the case status reflects exemptions applied.
verify: Open the case record and confirm the status field.
Pass when the status shows exemptions-applied with the memo attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: All incoming DSAR cases requiring identity verification before fulfillment
generic.In-scope period: From case intake to identity-verified status
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Verification method, matched identifiers, and verifier name populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: One verification record exists per open DSAR case
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Verification evidence and timestamp attached to the case record
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed verification attempts logged with the reason for rejection
generic.Test population: Sample of verified cases checked against the identifiers used
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires verification completed before data location begins
generic.Exception handling path: Failed verification routed back to requestor for additional proof
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Identity verified per the method matching the request's sensitivity tier
generic.Evidence location: DSAR case record in the GRC platform

steps.title: Determine the request's sensitivity tier
sop: Open the DSAR case in the GRC platform.
Review the request type and data categories involved.
Assign a sensitivity tier that sets the required verification method.
Done when the sensitivity tier is recorded on the case.
verify: Check the tier against the request type and data categories.
Pass when the tier matches the sensitivity guidance for that request type.

steps.title: Apply the matching identity-verification method
sop: Select knowledge-based verification or document upload per the assigned tier.
Send the requestor the verification instructions through the ITSM platform.
Collect the requestor's verification response or uploaded document.
Done when the verification method has been applied and a response received.
verify: Confirm the method used matches what the sensitivity tier requires.
Pass when the correct verification method was applied to the case.

steps.title: Match requestor identifiers against systems of record
sop: Pull the requestor's supplied name, DOB, and policy or claim number.
Query the systems of record in the GRC platform for a matching profile.
Note any discrepancy between supplied and on-file identifiers.
Done when the match result is recorded on the case.
verify: Review the match result against the systems-of-record query output.
Pass when all supplied identifiers match the on-file profile.

steps.title: Confirm authorization for an agent-submitted request
sop: Check whether the request was submitted by an authorized agent.
Request the power of attorney or written authorization document if not on file.
Confirm the authorization document names the requestor and the agent.
Done when authorization is confirmed on file or the request flagged unverified.
verify: Open the authorization document attached to the case.
Pass when the document is on file and names both parties correctly.

steps.title: Reject and log a failed verification attempt
sop: Identify any verification step that failed to match or produce evidence.
Send the requestor a request for additional proof through the ITSM platform.
Log the rejection reason on the DSAR case.
Done when the rejection and requested follow-up are logged.
verify: Check the case log for the rejection reason entry.
Pass when every failed attempt has a logged reason and follow-up request.

steps.title: Mark the case identity-verified
sop: Confirm all verification steps for the case passed.
Update the case status to identity-verified in the GRC platform.
Record the verifier name and verification timestamp.
Done when the case shows identity-verified before location work begins.
verify: Open the case status field and verifier entry.
Pass when the status is identity-verified with a name and timestamp recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every new DSAR intake pending request-type classification
generic.In-scope period: From intake receipt to sub-queue routing
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Request type tag and relationship field populated on the case
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: One classification tag set per intake case, multiple only for mixed requests
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Classification decision and routing timestamp recorded on the case
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Mismatched relationship-to-request-type cases logged with the correction made
generic.Test population: Sample of classified cases checked against the routed sub-queue
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires the routed sub-queue to match the assigned classification tag
generic.Exception handling path: Unsupported relationship claims routed back to intake for clarification
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Classification assigned only when the requestor's relationship supports the request type
generic.Evidence location: DSAR case record in the GRC platform

steps.title: Review the intake case and identify the request type
sop: Open the new case in the DSAR intake queue.
Read the original request text to identify what the requestor is asking for.
Note whether the request maps to access, deletion, correction, portability, or opt-out.
Done when a preliminary request type is identified.
verify: Reread the request text against the identified type.
Pass when the identified type matches the requestor's stated ask.

steps.title: Classify the case in the GRC platform
sop: Open the case classification field in the GRC platform.
Select the matching request-type tag: access, deletion, correction, portability, or opt-out.
Save the classification to the case record.
Done when the classification tag is saved.
verify: Open the saved case and confirm the tag field.
Pass when the tag matches the type identified in the request text.

steps.title: Flag mixed-type requests with multiple tags
sop: Check whether the request asks for more than one action, such as access plus deletion.
Apply each applicable classification tag to the case.
Note in the case comments that the request is mixed-type.
Done when all applicable tags are applied to a mixed request.
verify: Review the case tags against the original request text.
Pass when every distinct ask in the request has a corresponding tag.

steps.title: Confirm the requestor's relationship supports the claim
sop: Check the requestor's stated relationship: policyholder, claimant, or applicant.
Compare the relationship against the systems of record for the policy or claim.
Note any mismatch between stated relationship and the request type claimed.
Done when the relationship-to-request-type check is recorded.
verify: Review the recorded relationship check against the systems of record.
Pass when the relationship supports the request type or a mismatch is logged for correction.

steps.title: Route the case to the matching DSAR sub-queue
sop: Select the sub-queue matching the case's classification tag.
Move the case into that sub-queue in the GRC platform.
Confirm the sub-queue owner receives the routed case.
Done when the case appears in the correct sub-queue.
verify: Open the sub-queue and confirm the case is listed.
Pass when the case sits in the sub-queue matching its classification tag.

steps.title: Log the classification decision for the audit trail
sop: Record the classification date, tag, and routing sub-queue on the case timeline.
Note the relationship-verification outcome alongside the classification entry.
Save the completed classification log to the DSAR case record.
Done when the classification log entry is saved.
verify: Open the case timeline and locate the classification log entry.
Pass when the entry shows date, tag, and sub-queue destination.

generic.Defined scope/population: All located records for the current DSAR case pending compilation
generic.In-scope period: From completed data-location worklog to package sign-off
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Source system label and record count populated for each compiled section
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Compiled record count matches the hit count on the data-location worklog
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Compiled package saved to the SharePoint DSAR case folder with a version date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any unrelated third-party record found logged and removed before finalizing
generic.Test population: Full compiled package reviewed against the location worklog line by line
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires 100% of worklog hits represented in the compiled package
generic.Exception handling path: Formatting or completeness gaps routed back for re-compilation before sign-off
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Package is human-readable, complete against the worklog, and free of unrelated data
generic.Evidence location: DSAR case folder in SharePoint referenced from the GRC platform case

steps.title: Pull located records into a compilation workspace
sop: Open the data-location worklog for the case in the GRC platform.
Retrieve each source system's exported records into the SharePoint case folder.
Organize the files by source system name.
Done when all worklog hits are staged in the workspace.
verify: Compare the staged files against the worklog hit list.
Pass when every worklog hit has a corresponding staged file.

steps.title: Compile the located records into a single response package
sop: Merge the staged source-system files into one response package document.
Organize sections by source system to mirror the worklog.
Label each section with its source system name.
Done when the package contains one section per source system.
verify: Open the compiled package and check section labels against the worklog.
Pass when every source system in the worklog has a matching section.

steps.title: Quality-review the package against the location worklog
sop: Step through the worklog hit list and confirm each item appears in the package.
Note any worklog hit missing from the compiled package.
Correct missing items by re-pulling from the source system.
Done when every worklog hit is accounted for in the package.
verify: Recount the package entries against the worklog hit count.
Pass when the compiled count matches the worklog hit count exactly.

steps.title: Verify formatting is human-readable
sop: Scan the package for raw system codes, internal IDs, or unformatted exports.
Replace or translate any raw code with its human-readable label.
Confirm layout is consistent across all sections.
Done when no raw system code remains unexplained in the package.
verify: Spot-check three sections for raw codes or unreadable fields.
Pass when no unexplained raw system code is found.

steps.title: Confirm no unrelated third-party records were pulled in
sop: Scan each section for names or identifiers not belonging to the requestor.
Remove any unrelated third-party record found.
Note the removal in the case comments.
Done when the package contains only the requestor's own records.
verify: Review the final package for any non-requestor identifier.
Pass when no unrelated third-party record remains.

steps.title: Save the compiled package to the secure DSAR case folder
sop: Save the finalized package to the case's secure folder in SharePoint.
Confirm folder permissions restrict access to authorized DSAR staff.
Link the saved package location to the GRC case record.
Done when the package is saved and linked to the case.
verify: Open the GRC case record and confirm the SharePoint link resolves.
Pass when the linked package matches the finalized compiled version.

steps.title: Obtain Privacy Officer review sign-off
sop: Open the compiled package from the linked SharePoint folder.
Review completeness and formatting against the worklog summary.
Record approval or requested corrections on the case.
Done when sign-off is recorded before redaction review begins.
verify: Check the case record for the Privacy Officer's sign-off entry.
Pass when sign-off is recorded and dated on the case.

generic.Defined scope/population: Current DSAR case pending jurisdiction and deadline determination
generic.In-scope period: From intake record to deadline set on the case
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Jurisdiction, applicable statute, and calculated deadline populated on the case
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: One statutory deadline recorded per open case
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Deadline calculation and reminder date saved with the case record
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any extension basis and revised deadline logged with the qualifying reason
generic.Test population: Sample of cases checked for correct statute-to-jurisdiction mapping
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires the deadline to match the statutory day count from the receipt date
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous jurisdiction cases routed to Privacy Counsel before a deadline is set
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Deadline reflects the correct statute for the requestor's residency jurisdiction
generic.Evidence location: DSAR case record in the GRC platform

steps.title: Determine the requestor's residency jurisdiction
sop: Open the intake record for the case.
Read the requestor's stated home-state or residency address.
Record the jurisdiction on the case.
Done when the jurisdiction field is populated.
verify: Compare the recorded jurisdiction against the intake address.
Pass when the jurisdiction matches the requestor's stated residency.

steps.title: Identify the applicable statute for the jurisdiction
sop: Cross-reference the jurisdiction against the statute mapping table.
Select the statute that governs the requestor's case, such as CCPA or a state insurance privacy regulation.
Record the statute name on the case.
Done when the applicable statute is recorded.
verify: Check the recorded statute against the jurisdiction mapping table.
Pass when the statute matches the requestor's jurisdiction.

steps.title: Calculate the statutory response deadline
sop: Take the case receipt date as the calculation start point.
Add the statute's required response window, such as 45 days for CCPA or 30 for a GLBA-state variant.
Record the calculated due date on the case.
Done when the deadline date is saved.
verify: Recalculate the day count from receipt date to the recorded deadline.
Pass when the calculated deadline matches the statute's required window.

steps.title: Set a reminder ahead of the due date
sop: Open the case reminder settings in the GRC platform.
Set a reminder several business days before the calculated deadline.
Confirm the reminder is assigned to the case owner.
Done when the reminder is active on the case.
verify: Check the GRC platform reminder queue for the case.
Pass when an active reminder exists ahead of the recorded deadline.

steps.title: Note any permitted extension basis
sop: Review the case for circumstances qualifying for a statutory extension.
Confirm the extension basis against the applicable statute's provisions.
Record the revised deadline and extension reason on the case.
Done when the extension basis and revised deadline are documented.
verify: Check the case record for the extension basis and revised deadline.
Pass when a documented statutory basis supports any revised deadline.

steps.title: Confirm the deadline determination before fulfillment proceeds
sop: Review the jurisdiction, statute, and deadline recorded on the case.
Confirm the determination is consistent with current statutory guidance.
Record concurrence on the case record.
Done when Privacy Counsel concurrence is recorded.
verify: Open the case and locate the concurrence entry.
Pass when concurrence is recorded before fulfillment work begins.

generic.Defined scope/population: All DSAR cases reaching final disposition in the reporting period
generic.In-scope period: From case closure through evidence archival
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Disposition status, closure date, and elapsed-days-to-close populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived case count matches the closed-case count for the period
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Acknowledgment, verification, and response-sent artifacts attached with timestamps
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any case missing a required artifact logged until resolved before archival
generic.Test population: Sample of closed cases checked for complete disposition and evidence
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires every closed case to carry disposition, evidence, and a retention tag
generic.Exception handling path: Cases missing evidence routed back to the case owner before archiving
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Disposition recorded, evidence attached, and retention period applied before archival
generic.Evidence location: Compliance evidence repository, cross-referenced by DSAR case number

steps.title: Record the final disposition and closure date
sop: Open the completed case in the GRC platform.
Select the final disposition: fulfilled, denied, or partial.
Enter the closure date on the case record.
Done when disposition and closure date are saved.
verify: Open the case record and confirm the disposition field.
Pass when disposition and closure date are both populated.

steps.title: Attach evidence of timely response
sop: Gather the acknowledgment, verification, and response-sent artifacts for the case.
Attach each artifact to the DSAR case record.
Label each artifact by type and date.
Done when all required artifacts are attached.
verify: Open the case attachments and check for each artifact type.
Pass when acknowledgment, verification, and response-sent artifacts are all present.

steps.title: Confirm the elapsed-days-to-close figure
sop: Calculate the days between receipt date and closure date.
Enter the elapsed-days figure on the case for SLA reporting.
Flag any case exceeding the statutory deadline for review.
Done when the elapsed-days figure is recorded.
verify: Recalculate the elapsed days from the case dates.
Pass when the recorded figure matches the recalculated value.

steps.title: Apply the applicable retention period
sop: Determine the retention period applicable to the closed case type.
Set the retention/disposal date on the case record.
Confirm the retention tag matches policy for DSAR case records.
Done when the retention period is applied.
verify: Open the case record and check the retention tag.
Pass when the retention date matches the applicable policy period.

steps.title: Archive the case in the compliance evidence repository
sop: Export the closed case record with attached evidence.
Upload the export to the compliance evidence repository.
Cross-reference the archived entry with the DSAR case number.
Done when the case is archived with a working cross-reference.
verify: Search the compliance evidence repository by case number.
Pass when the archived entry is found with all evidence attached.

steps.title: Log the archival completion on the DSAR case
sop: Confirm the archived entry is accessible in the compliance evidence repository.
Update the DSAR case status to archived.
Note the archival date and repository reference on the case.
Done when the case shows archived with a repository reference.
verify: Open the case and confirm the archived status and reference.
Pass when the case shows archived with a valid repository link.

generic.Defined scope/population: DSAR cases with a requestor objection to denial or appeal of disposition
generic.In-scope period: From objection/appeal receipt to final resolution communicated
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Escalation ticket number, target resolution date, and resolution rationale populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: One ITSM escalation ticket exists per objected or appealed case
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Privacy Counsel's resolution decision and rationale timestamped on the case
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any missed appeal-timeline case logged with the cause and corrective action
generic.Test population: Sample of escalated cases checked for full history routed and resolution recorded
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires resolution communicated within the applicable appeal timeline
generic.Exception handling path: Cases nearing the appeal timeline without resolution escalated further to Privacy Counsel
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case escalated with full history, resolved by Privacy Counsel, requestor notified on time
generic.Evidence location: DSAR case record in the GRC platform, cross-referenced with the ITSM escalation ticket

steps.title: Identify cases with an objection or appeal
sop: Review incoming requestor communications for objections to a denial or appeals of disposition.
Confirm the case already has a recorded disposition being contested.
Flag the case as under-appeal in the GRC platform.
Done when the case is flagged as an appeal or objection.
verify: Open the flagged case and confirm the appeal flag is set.
Pass when the flag matches a genuine objection or appeal request.

steps.title: Route the case with full history to Privacy Counsel
sop: Compile the request, verification, and exemptions-applied history for the case.
Attach the compiled history to the escalation record.
Assign the escalation to Privacy Counsel in the GRC platform.
Done when the full history is attached and routed.
verify: Open the escalation record and confirm attached history sections.
Pass when request, verification, and exemption history are all present.

steps.title: Open an ITSM tracking item for the escalation
sop: Create a new ticket in the ITSM platform for the escalation.
Set a target resolution date within the applicable appeal timeline.
Link the ITSM ticket number back to the DSAR case.
Done when the ITSM ticket is open and linked.
verify: Open the ITSM ticket and confirm the linked DSAR case number.
Pass when the ticket carries a target date within the appeal timeline.

steps.title: Record Privacy Counsel's resolution decision
sop: Review the routed history and the requestor's stated objection or appeal.
Determine the final resolution and its rationale.
Enter the decision and rationale on the DSAR case.
Done when the resolution decision is recorded.
verify: Open the case and locate the resolution decision entry.
Pass when the entry includes both a decision and a rationale.

steps.title: Communicate the final resolution to the requestor
sop: Draft the resolution communication based on Privacy Counsel's decision.
Send the communication through the requestor's original channel.
Confirm the communication is sent within the applicable appeal timeline.
Done when the resolution has been sent to the requestor.
verify: Check the send timestamp against the appeal timeline deadline.
Pass when the communication was sent on or before the deadline.

steps.title: Close the escalation ticket and case
sop: Confirm the requestor communication was delivered successfully.
Close the ITSM escalation ticket with the resolution reference.
Update the DSAR case status to resolved-appeal.
Done when both the ticket and case reflect resolved status.
verify: Check the ITSM ticket and DSAR case status fields.
Pass when both show closed/resolved with matching resolution reference.

generic.Defined scope/population: All systems of record requiring deletion or correction for the case
generic.In-scope period: From approved change through downstream propagation confirmation
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Change ticket number and target system populated for each required change
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Closed ticket count matches the number of systems of record requiring change
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Closed ITSM ticket references attached to the DSAR case as execution evidence
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any system failing propagation confirmation logged with remediation status
generic.Test population: Data catalog re-query results checked against each executed change
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires the record to no longer surface or reflect the correction across systems
generic.Exception handling path: Propagation failures routed back to IT for re-execution before case closure
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Change executed in the source system and confirmed propagated to all downstream copies
generic.Evidence location: DSAR case record in the GRC platform with linked ITSM ticket references

steps.title: File an ITSM change ticket for each system of record
sop: Identify every system of record holding the requestor's data needing deletion or correction.
Open one ITSM change ticket per system.
Describe the required deletion or correction on each ticket.
Done when a ticket exists for every in-scope system.
verify: Count the open tickets against the list of in-scope systems.
Pass when every in-scope system has a corresponding ticket.

steps.title: Execute the deletion or correction in the source system
sop: Open the approved change ticket for the source system.
Apply the deletion or correction per the approved change description.
Record the execution date and executor name on the ticket.
Done when the change is applied in the source system.
verify: Query the source system for the affected record.
Pass when the record is deleted or shows the corrected values.

steps.title: Confirm propagation to downstream copies
sop: Identify downstream copies: data warehouse, marketing platform, backups per retention policy.
Check each downstream copy for the applied change.
Note any downstream system still showing the old data.
Done when propagation status is recorded for every downstream copy.
verify: Review the propagation status list against the downstream copy inventory.
Pass when every downstream copy shows the change applied or an exception logged.

steps.title: Re-query the data catalog to confirm the change
sop: Open the data catalog/quality tool and search for the requestor's record.
Confirm the record no longer surfaces for deletion or reflects the correction.
Note the re-query result on the DSAR case.
Done when the re-query confirms the expected outcome.
verify: Compare the re-query result to the expected outcome (absent or corrected).
Pass when the data catalog result matches the requested change.

steps.title: Attach closed ITSM ticket references as evidence
sop: Confirm every change ticket is marked closed in the ITSM platform.
Copy each closed ticket's reference number to the DSAR case.
Attach the propagation confirmation notes alongside the ticket references.
Done when all ticket references and confirmations are attached.
verify: Open the DSAR case and check the attached ticket references.
Pass when every filed ticket is closed and referenced on the case.

steps.title: Close out the execution step on the DSAR case
sop: Confirm every ticket is closed and every re-query result is satisfactory.
Update the DSAR case status to execution-complete.
Notify the case owner the request is ready for final response.
Done when the case reflects execution-complete status.
verify: Open the case and confirm the status field.
Pass when the status shows execution-complete with all evidence attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: Current DSAR case tracked against its recorded statutory deadline
generic.In-scope period: From verification start through fulfillment completion
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Fulfillment completion date populated relative to the recorded statutory deadline
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: All fulfillment steps (verification, location, compilation, redaction) show complete
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Fulfillment completion date recorded against the statutory deadline for SLA reporting
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any case within 5 business days of deadline flagged and logged for priority handling
generic.Test population: Sample of fulfilled cases checked for on-time completion against recorded deadlines
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires completion date on or before the recorded statutory deadline
generic.Exception handling path: Cases at risk of missing deadline escalated to Privacy Officer for priority handling
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No fulfillment step remains open in the DSAR queue before sign-off
generic.Evidence location: DSAR case record in the GRC platform

steps.title: Compare case status against the statutory deadline
sop: Open the case record and read the recorded statutory deadline.
Compare today's date against the recorded deadline.
Note the number of days remaining or overdue.
Done when the days-remaining figure is recorded on the case.
verify: Recalculate the days-remaining figure from the case dates.
Pass when the recorded figure matches the recalculated value.

steps.title: Confirm all fulfillment steps are complete
sop: Check the case for completed verification, location, compilation, and redaction steps.
Note any step still showing open or in-progress.
Follow up on any incomplete step before proceeding.
Done when every fulfillment step shows complete.
verify: Review the case step checklist for outstanding items.
Pass when verification, location, compilation, and redaction all show complete.

steps.title: Flag cases within 5 business days of deadline
sop: Identify cases where the deadline falls within 5 business days.
Apply a priority-handling flag to those cases in the GRC platform.
Notify the Privacy Officer of the flagged cases.
Done when at-risk cases are flagged and the Privacy Officer notified.
verify: Check the GRC platform for the priority flag on at-risk cases.
Pass when every case within 5 business days of deadline is flagged.

steps.title: Confirm no fulfillment step remains open before sign-off
sop: Review the case's fulfillment checklist for any open item.
Confirm with the case owner that no step remains outstanding.
Record sign-off readiness on the case.
Done when the case is confirmed ready for closure.
verify: Open the case and confirm no fulfillment step is marked open.
Pass when every step is confirmed complete before sign-off.

steps.title: Record the fulfillment completion date for SLA reporting
sop: Enter the fulfillment completion date on the DSAR case.
Compare the completion date to the recorded statutory deadline.
Note the on-time or late result for SLA reporting.
Done when the completion date and SLA result are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded completion date to the statutory deadline.
Pass when the completion date is on or before the statutory deadline.

steps.title: Escalate any case trending toward a missed deadline
sop: Review flagged at-risk cases nearing their statutory deadline.
Assign additional resources or prioritize the case in the queue.
Log the escalation action taken on the case.
Done when an escalation action is logged for each at-risk case.
verify: Check flagged at-risk cases for a logged escalation action.
Pass when every at-risk case shows an escalation action before its deadline.

generic.Defined scope/population: DSAR cases ready for final response issuance and closure
generic.In-scope period: From disposition finalized to case closed
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Response-sent timestamp and closure status populated on the case
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Closed case count on the Power BI dashboard matches the GRC platform closed count
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Response-sent timestamp and channel recorded on the DSAR case
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any case closing after the SLA date logged with the cause
generic.Test population: Sample of closed cases checked against the SLA date shown on the dashboard
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass requires case closure on or before the SLA date
generic.Exception handling path: Cases at risk of missing SLA escalated before the final response is sent
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Response sent via the requestor's preferred channel and case closed within SLA
generic.Evidence location: DSAR case record in the GRC platform, cross-checked against the Power BI dashboard

steps.title: Assemble the final response letter
sop: Open the case's finalized disposition (fulfilled, denied, or partial with exemptions).
Draft the response letter summarizing the disposition in plain language.
Reference any applied exemptions in the letter where applicable.
Done when the response letter draft is complete.
verify: Read the draft letter against the case disposition.

Pass when every change has a documented rationale tied to the driver.

steps.title: Route the redline for approval
sop: Send the drafted redline to Privacy Counsel and the policy owner.
Collect approval or requested changes from both reviewers.
Record the approval outcome on the GRC platform record.
Done when approval is recorded for every redline.
verify: Check the GRC platform for the recorded approval outcome.
Pass when every redline shows approval before publication.

steps.title: Publish the revised policy version with effective date
sop: Finalize the approved redline into the published policy format.
Publish the revised policy to the policy library with its effective date.
Confirm the published version matches the approved redline.
Done when the revised policy is published with an effective date.
verify: Open the policy library and confirm the published version and effective date.
Pass when the published policy matches the approved redline exactly.

steps.title: Retire the prior policy version per the retention schedule
sop: Identify the prior version being superseded.
Archive the prior version per the applicable retention schedule.
Confirm the archived version remains retrievable, not deleted.
Done when the prior version is archived per the retention schedule.
verify: Search the policy library archive for the prior version.
Pass when the prior version is retrievable in archive with the retirement date noted.

steps.title: Confirm publication is logged for the update cycle
sop: Confirm the revised policy and prior-version archival are both complete.
Log the update cycle completion in the GRC platform.
Notify stakeholders of the published policy update.
Done when the update cycle is logged complete and stakeholders notified.
verify: Check the GRC platform for the logged update-cycle completion.
Pass when the completion entry references the published policy and notified stakeholders.
